name: ai-workload
description: Starter policy for the agentic era: model images and LLM-facing workloads carry extra provenance and isolation requirements.

rules.description: An image tagged as carrying model weights must ship a signed AI-BOM attestation.
rules.message: model image is missing a signed AI-BOM attestation
rules.remediation: Generate and attach a signed AI-BOM: dsecrat attest --type ai-bom --image <ref>

rules.description: An LLM-facing workload must not expose the host network or a hostPath, which would hand an agent a path to the node.
rules.message: LLM-facing workload exposes an unsafe host tool/network scope
rules.remediation: Remove hostNetwork and hostPath mounts; give the agent only the network egress it needs.

rules.description: Deployments produced by an automated agent must carry a verified agent-action attestation.
rules.remediation: Have the agent emit an attested action: dsecrat attest --type agent-action --image <ref>
